checks.explanation: This is a 5-10 year forecast (to roughly 2030-2035) made in September 2025. As of August 2026, no system has been widely recognized as meeting Hassabis's own bar for AGI (true creative/intuitive leaps, consistent PhD-level generality). The timeframe has not elapsed, so this cannot be evaluated yet.

Isomorphic Labs' collaborations with Eli Lilly and Novartis progressed from target identification to generating multiple AI-designed preclinical candidates by early 2026, matching Hassabis's 'sometime next year' prediction, and the company is now targeting a first-in-human trial for an IsoDDE-designed candidate by end of 2026.

sources.title: Isomorphic Labs prepares to launch trials for AI-designed drugs
